label: ACCEPT
reason: Every generated icon (REST-api.ts, database.ts, sentry.ts) passes an svgDefaults object with fill to the default export of createSupabaseIcon.ts (locally named createLucideIcon, imported as createSupabaseIcon, hence clear: false); svgDefaults is optional so tsc does not catch omission, and validateIcons.mjs only checks raw SVGs in the local build:icons script, not in CI. With no counted outliers, a fill-only icon like sentry.ts without fill would fall back to defaultAttributes fill 'none' and render blank, so flagging is worth it; hesitated with WRONG incidental since for stroke icons fill 'none' duplicates the default and the attribute is just copied by exportTemplate.mjs.
